A Aegea

Criada em 2010, a Aegea é líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Em cada município onde atua, leva mais saúde e qualidade de vida para a população, respeitando sempre o meio ambiente e a cultura local.

A Concessionária

A Águas do Rio, concessionária da Aegea, é responsável pelo abastecimento de água e esgotamento sanitário em 27 municípios do estado do Rio Janeiro incluindo 124 bairros da capital, atendendo 10 milhões de pessoas.

Durante o período de concessão, iniciado em 1º de novembro de 2021, a companhia realizou o maior investimento em saneamento básico no país, em torno de R$ 39 bilhões. R$ 15,4 bilhões em outorga, para serem aplicados em projetos prioritários dos governos estadual e municipais, e R$ 24,4 bilhões para a universalização dos serviços de água e esgoto, que será alcançada nos primeiros 12 anos, em alinhamento ao novo Marco Regulatório de Saneamento.

Programa Respeito dá o Tom

O programa nasceu com a meta de espelhar a demografia da população brasileira no quadro de funcionários da empresa.

Em 2022 a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança.

A Aegea tem o compromisso com a promoção de um ambiente de trabalho mais igualitário, diverso e inclusivo, e estimula o respeito e a valorização das diferenças.

Aqui, todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados no processo seletivo, independentemente de raça, gênero, orientação sexual, religião, naturalidade, nacional deficiência, idade ou outras características.

description:
Mechanical Engineer - Static Equipment - Rio

Join to apply for the Mechanical Engineer - Static Equipment - Rio role at Hanwha Ocean

1 day ago | Be among the first 25 applicants

Description

Hanwha Ocean is undergoing a transformative journey, evolving from a traditional shipbuilder to an Engineering, Procurement, Construction, Installation, and Operation (EPCI(O)) solution provider, offering products such as FPSO, FLNG, Offshore Renewables and other Floating Production Units. The Energy Plant Unit has expanded its global footprint by establishing new Global Business Centers to become a project‑centric and client‑driven organization, bridging upstream cultures across Asia, Europe, and America. Explore opportunities to be part of our dynamic team and contribute to groundbreaking projects that redefine the offshore industry.

Location: Rio de Janeiro, Brazil, RJ, BR

Requisition ID: 1285

Position Overview

The Mechanical Engineer – Static Equipment is a senior technical authority responsible for leading the design and engineering of static mechanical equipment for offshore facilities, particularly FPSO and FLNG topsides. This role covers the full project lifecycle—from concept and pre‑FEED through detailed design and commissioning. The Principal Mechanical Engineer will act as the focal point for mechanical static equipment, guide multidisciplinary teams, interface with vendors and clients, and ensure compliance with international codes and quality standards. This role may require frequent travel to the US, Europe, and/or Asia.

The ideal candidate has a strong background in the Offshore Oil & Gas Industry, expertise in Static Equipment, and a strategic focus in the Topsides Concept Layout for Conceptual/pre‑FEED/FEED/EPC(I) projects being bid in the offshore area, including FPSO, FLNG, and other Fixed and Floating platforms/facilities.

Key Responsibilities

Engineering & Design

  • Lead the selection, design, and specification of static mechanical equipment including pressure vessels, tanks, and heat exchangers for offshore topside modules.
  • Prepare, maintain and review technical deliverables such as Equipment List, Specifications, Datasheets, RFQs, and Technical Bid Evaluations.
  • Conduct material selection studies and ensure designs comply with applicable codes (ASME, API, DNV, etc.).
  • Support the development of topsides layouts and ensure optimal equipment arrangement in early design phases.

Vendor & Procurement Support

  • Prepare Material Requisitions for the RFQs.
  • Evaluate vendor proposals, clarify technical aspects, and attend vendor meetings.
  • Review and approve vendor documents and engineering drawings.
  • Conduct vendor audits and manufacturing facility visits to verify capability, testing, and compliance.

Project Execution & Support

  • Support execution of TENDER, CONCEPT, FEED, EPC(I), and commissioning phases for FPSO / FLNG and Fixed Platforms.
  • Participate in engineering risk assessments, design reviews, and interface coordination.
  • Resolve technical issues arising during fabrication, integration, or offshore installation.

Team Leadership & Mentoring

  • Provide technical mentorship to junior engineers and review their work for accuracy and completeness.
  • Lead or participate in design teams, ensuring adherence to project scope and technical requirements.
  • Promote knowledge sharing and contribute to continuous improvement of engineering processes.

Standards, QA/QC & Documentation

  • Develop and maintain corporate and project‑specific standards for static mechanical equipment.
  • Respond to comments and queries from other Hanwha offices, classification societies and clients.
  • Maintain accurate records and ensure documentation meets quality and project control standards.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering (Master’s preferred).
  • Minimum 15 years of experience in Mechanical Engineering, with significant experience in leading complex engineering projects in the offshore oil and gas industry.
  • Prior experience with FPSO or FLNG design development and/or engineering project delivery at a top‑tier FPSO contractor preferred.
  • Strong background in static equipment engineering (pressure vessels, heat exchangers, tanks).
  • Proven track record of success in developing and performing static equipment conceptual / feasibility studies during pre‑FEED/FEED or tender stage.
  • Knowledge of applicable international design codes and standards (ASME Section VIII, API 650/660/661, EN 13445, PED, etc.).
  • Proficiency in engineering software and tools for design, analysis, and simulation of static equipment (e.g., PV Elite, Compress) and 3D model review tools (e.g., AVEVA E3D, Navisworks).
  • Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills, with ability to develop innovative solutions to complex engineering challenges.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead engineering teams and build and maintain positive relationships with clients, shipyards, vendors, and other stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage and deliver multiple priorities and projects simultaneously, ensuring high‑quality outcomes within scope, schedule, and budget.
  • Effective communicator with excellent written and verbal English skills.
  • Ability to influence and negotiate effectively to achieve project and organizational objectives.
  • High level of integrity, professionalism, and ethical conduct.
  • Proactive, adaptable, and resilient; able to thrive in a dynamic and challenging work environment.
  • Membership in relevant professional organizations and active participation in industry events and conferences desirable.
  • Willingness to travel internationally as required.

· Avaliar os impactos e oportunidades decorrentes das mudanças, visando otimizar a carga tributária, alavancar créditos tributários e adequar o modelo de negócios.

About The Role

We are looking for a Tax Analyst to support our Tax Team with Brazilian tax demands. This role is a great opportunity for someone at the beginning of their career who wants to deepen their experience in tax compliance within a dynamic, global, and technology-driven environment. You will work closely with accounting, finance, and external partners to ensure our tax processes in Brazil run smoothly and in full compliance with legislation.

About The Team

Our VTEX Tax Team manages every aspect related to tax planning and compliance, focusing on accuracy, efficiency, and continuous improvement of our global tax operations. In Brazil, the team plays a critical role in ensuring compliance with local requirements while collaborating with other regions to maintain alignment with global standards. As part of this team, you will:

  • Manage tax and accounting activities ensuring compliance with Brazilian tax regulations;
  • Review and calculate Direct and Indirect Tax and returns;
  • Register and reconcile journal entries related to tax accounts (recoverable, payable, and expense accounts);
  • Keep the accounting reconciliations for tax accounts updated and accurate;
  • Support the implementation and improvement of SOX controls;
  • Stay up to date with changes in Brazilian tax legislation, sharing key updates with the team;
  • Help clarify withholding tax questions from internal stakeholders;
  • Prepare documentation for tax audits and inspections;
  • Collaborate with local and global teams to ensure alignment between tax, accounting, and finance processes.

Who You Are

  • You are based in Rio de Janeiro and willing to go to the office 1–2x a week;
  • You have a Bachelor’s degree (completed) in Accounting, Business Administration, Law, Economics, or related areas;
  • You have 3–5 years of experience in Tax or Accounting, ideally in a corporate environment or consulting firm;
  • Solid understanding of Brazilian tax legislation;
  • Knowledge of journal entries and reconciliation of tax accounts (assets, liabilities, and P&L);
  • Experience with SAP or other ERP systems is a plus;
  • Strong analytical skills and attention to detail;
  • Advanced user of Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets;
  • Good communication skills and a collaborative mindset;
  • Intermediate English — comfortable reading documentation and communicating with global peers when necessary.

About VTEX

VTEX (NYSE: VTEX) is the composable and complete commerce platform that delivers more efficiency and less maintenance to organizations seeking to make smarter IT investments and modernize their tech stack. Through our pragmatic composability approach, we empower brands, distributors, and retailers with unparalleled flexibility and comprehensive solutions, enabling them to invest solely in what provides a clear business advantage and boosts profitability. VTEX is trusted by 2.4 thousand global B2C and B2B customers, including Carrefour, Colgate, Motorola, Sony, Stanley Black & Decker, and Whirlpool, having 3.4 thousand active online stores across 43 countries (as of FY ended on December 31, 2024). We are building an extraordinary future with more than 1,300 employees scattered across 25 locations in 16 countries in Latin America, North America, Europe, and Asia.

At VTEX, you will work in a challenge-driven environment and collaborate with amazing peers. If you are powerful individually, join us, and we will be unstoppable together.

AgileEngine is an Inc. 5000 company that creates award-winning software for Fortune 500 brands and trailblazing startups across 17+ industries. We rank among the leaders in areas like application development and AI/ML, and our people‑first culture has earned us multiple Best Place to Work awards.

WHY JOIN US

If you're looking for a place to grow, make an impact, and work with people who care, we'd love to meet you!

ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Data Engineer , you’ll play a key role in ensuring smooth and successful device launches through observability, test automation, and real‑time launch support. You’ll transform raw telemetry into actionable insights, build dashboards and anomaly detection systems, and automate data validation workflows. This role offers the opportunity to work on cutting‑edge devices, collaborate cross‑functionally, and directly impact product reliability and customer experience.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Turn raw device telemetry into actionable alerts with strong observability, data quality, and launch support baked in.
  • Work with cross‑functional teams to establish device observability and health monitoring.
  • Define logging, metrics, and traces for device and pipeline health, and ship dashboards for latency, uptime, error rates, and crash signals.
  • Add anomaly detection over telemetry and logs and track health KPIs during launches.
  • Develop automated anomaly detection for logging anomalies in device telemetry.
  • Build dashboards to track device health and ensure all data artifacts have proper quality, integrity, and reliability.
  • Participate in remote or on‑site go‑lives to monitor device health and triage issues in real time using dashboards.
  • Collaborate with QA to ensure access to proper data and pipelines for testing and build automations as needed.
  • Develop tooling to simulate various on‑device scenarios for launch‑readiness.
  • Support on‑site testing and live device launches remotely by monitoring device health based on metrics and dashboards.
  • Triage issues in real time by analyzing logs and identifying failure sources to enable rapid resolution and successful launches.

MUST HAVES

  • 5–8+ years of experience in data engineering with Spark (Structured Streaming) or similar tools in production.
  • Proficiency in Python and strong SQL/pandas skills.
  • Solid understanding of streaming fundamentals.
  • Experience building alerting, monitoring, or observability systems.
  • Experience turning manual checks into automated guardrails.
  • Comfortable supporting live device rollouts and post‑launch monitoring.
  • Upper‑intermediate English level.

PERKS AND BENEFITS

  • Professional growth: Accelerate your professional journey with mentorship, TechTalks, and personalized growth roadmaps.
  • Competitive compensation: We match your ever‑growing skills, talent, and contributions with competitive USD‑based compensation and budgets for education, fitness, and team activities.
  • A selection of exciting projects: Join projects with modern solutions development and top‑tier clients that include Fortune 500 enterprises and leading product brands.
  • Flextime: Tailor your schedule for an optimal work‑life balance, by having the options of working from home and going to the office – whatever makes you the happiest and most productive.

title: Risk Management Specialist - Model Risk Data Science and AI Models
description:
About Us

Nu is one of the largest digital financial platforms in the world, with more than 122 million customers across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia. Guided by our mission to fight complexity and empower people, we are redefining financial services in Latin America and this is still just the beginning of the purple future we're building.
Listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: NU), we combine proprietary technology, data intelligence, and an efficient operating model to deliver financial products that are simple, accessible, and human.
Our impact has been recognized by global rankings such as Time 100 Companies, Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies, and Forbes World’s Best Bank.

About the Team

At Nubank we heavily rely on data, machine learning and other quantitative models & techniques to drive our strategy and provide the best experience and products to our customers.
The position holder will be part of the Model Risk team, within the Risk Management structure at Nubank.
The Model Risk team is the second line of defense for our models. Our mission is to ensure Nubank relies on world-class solutions that will lead to optimal and sustainable decisions. We act by providing independent review & challenge to models, staying tuned to cutting edge techniques, along with business and customers needs. We also work to identify and control risks related to our models, as well as in the definition and implementation of feedback loops to constantly improve them.

About the Role

Provide effective challenges, identify risks, and enhancement opportunities, and engage with other Data Scientists and Business Analysts to strengthen our decision-making tools;
Discuss and report model risk status and independent opinions on models with different stakeholders, including senior managers and regulators;
Contribute to the consolidation of and improve Nubank's Model Risk Management and Model Review frameworks with autonomy and creativity;
Be exposed to different types of decisions and processes (e.g. credit, fraud, operations and in different countries);
Conduct independent reviews of quantitative models based on statistical, machine learning and AI techniques, with a stronger focus on credit models;
Develop playbooks and toolkits (Python, Scala, SQL, etc.) to optimize model reviews, ongoing models monitoring, and assess the impact of models in decisions;
Ensure the team maintains a high level of technical excellence.

Qualifications

  • Great communication skills: clear, concise and structured.
  • Problem‑solving skills: strong analytical and problem‑solving abilities are essential for identifying risk factors and implementing effective risk management strategies.
  • Experience developing or validating machine learning models used to leverage important decision‑making processes or to solve relevant academic problems.
  • Interest in reviewing complex machine learning and other types of models to identify risks and propose enhancements.
  • Ability to work autonomously and demonstrate a sense of prioritization.
  • Data Science skills, strong knowledge of machine learning tools and techniques.
  • Strong programming skills, desirable previous experience with Python, SQL, GitHub.
  • Stakeholder management and influencing skills across levels.
  • Organized and detail‑oriented, without losing track of the big picture.
  • Advanced English skills.
  • Previous experience in credit risk management and/or other risk management frameworks would be a plus.
  • Master’s degree or relevant undergraduate scientific project would be a plus.
  • Previous knowledge of expected loss provisions modeling would be a plus.

Estamos em busca de alguém com mentalidade de dono, motivado(a) a abraçar responsabilidades e tomar iniciativas constantemente. Não queremos apenas um funcionário, mas alguém que queira fazer a diferença e enfrentar desafios junto com uma equipe determinada a transformar o mercado de energia no Brasil.

Se você se identifica com esse perfil, candidate-se agora mesmo e seja parte de uma equipe dinâmica, colaborativa, criativa e inovadora.

A Órigo Energia reconhece a diversidade de perspectivas, experiências e identidades que nossos colaboradores trazem para o ambiente de trabalho. Nesse contexto acreditamos firmemente que a inclusão é a chave para um crescimento sustentável e uma cultura empresarial verdadeiramente enriquecedora.

Por este motivo, estamos comprometidos com a igualdade de oportunidades no processo de contratação. Isso significa que todos os candidatos serão tratados de forma justa e imparcial, sem discriminação com base em raça, cor, gênero, religião, orientação sexual, idade, estado civil ou qualquer outra característica.

Aqui você terá oportunidades de crescimento profissional e usará a sua energia para impactar positivamente o mundo.

Sobre a Posição

O Coordenador de Performance será responsável por monitorar, analisar e otimizar os indicadores de desempenho relacionados à construção de fazendas solares, assegurando eficiência operacional, qualidade, segurança e cumprimento de prazos. Atuará na consolidação de dados, identificação de desvios, proposição de soluções e suporte às lideranças na tomada de decisão estratégica, influenciando diretamente a rentabilidade e produtividade dos projetos.

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver, acompanhar e reportar indicadores de performance do funcionamento das usinas solares (prazo, custo, produtividade, qualidade e segurança).
  • Estruturar análises de eficiência operacional e financeira, propondo planos de ação para melhoria contínua.
  • Automatizar relatórios e processos de monitoramento utilizando ferramentas de análise de dados (Power BI, Excel avançado, SQL ou similares).
  • Coordenar a integração e fluxo de informações entre Engenharia, Planejamento, Suprimentos, Qualidade, Segurança e Operações.
  • Realizar análises de causas raiz para desvios de performance, propondo soluções e coordenando planos corretivos/preventivos.
  • Suportar a gestão na elaboração de apresentações executivas e materiais estratégicos para diretoria.
  • Garantir governança na gestão dos indicadores, padronizando metodologias, dashboards, rituais de acompanhamento e métricas.
  • Atuar como facilitador na cultura orientada a dados, promovendo precisão, consistência e visibilidade para a operação.
  • Acompanhar marcos críticos dos projetos, sinalizando riscos e oportunidades de melhoria.

Requisitos e Qualificações

  • Formação superior em Engenharia, Administração, Economia ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência prévia com análise de performance, planejamento ou PMO, preferencialmente no setor de energia ou construção pesada.
  • Conhecimento avançado em Excel e ferramentas de BI (Power BI, Tableau, Qlik).
  • Desejável vivência com metodologias de projetos (PMBOK, Lean, Six Sigma).
  • Capacidade analítica, visão sistêmica, organização e forte orientação a resultados.
  • Excelente comunicação para interação com diferentes áreas e níveis hierárquicos.
  • Inglês Fluente (Reuniões diárias)
  • Plano de saúde e odontológico para titular e dependentes
  • Vale Refeição no valor de R$ 42,00/dia para aproveitar suas pausas com sabor
  • Seguro de Vida para sua segurança e tranquilidade
  • VT para facilitar seus deslocamentos
  • Gympass para incentivar um estilo de vida saudável
  • Horário flexível para equilibrar vida pessoal e profissional
  • Programas de Capacitação para impulsionar seu desenvolvimento
  • Educação sobre ESG com apoio do Pacto Global Academy para estar por dentro das tendências

Aqui na Órigo Energia, a nossa paixão pela energia renovável é genuína! Somos pioneiros no Brasil quando se trata de construir Usinas Fotovoltaicas para Geração Distribuída, ou, como gostamos de chamar, Fazendas Solares. Nossa expertise está em aproveitar ao máximo o sol abundante do nosso país, gerando energia limpa com muito orgulho!

Nosso objetivo é proporcionar acesso, informação e oportunidades para todos. Queremos tornar a energia renovável uma realidade ao alcance de todos os brasileiros, não importa onde vivam. Nossa meta é permitir que cada pessoa participe ativamente da transição para um futuro mais sustentável e ambientalmente responsável.

A nossa história fala por si só. Com mais de 12 anos de experiência no mercado, os últimos três foram dedicados integralmente às nossas Fazendas Solares. Atualmente, temos mais de 100 Fazendas Solares em pleno funcionamento e outras em construção ou em processo de conexão. Já ajudamos mais de 80 mil clientes a economizarem mais de R$ 100 milhões em suas contas de luz. Além disso, com a energia que geramos, contribuímos para evitar a emissão de mais de 200mil toneladas de CO2 na atmosfera.

Diariamente, moldamos a empresa que desejamos ser com paixão e propósito, e fazemos parte de um movimento global que usa o poder dos negócios para promover o bem. Nosso compromisso com a sustentabilidade e a responsabilidade social é absoluto. O futuro sustentável está em curso neste exato momento, e é com orgulho que estamos contribuindo para torná-lo realidade!

title: Email Marketing Associate
description:
About Darkroom

Darkroom is a technology-driven growth marketing firm focused on growth-stage consumer companies. We were founded in 2017 out of a conviction that the iconic ad agencies of tomorrow would look very different. Darkroom is a human services firm built on a universal AI commerce layer called Matter. Our model deploys a unique blend of senior, human resources enriched by an agentic technology stack that enhances output, efficiency, and revenue generation for our clients.

Our team has been responsible for billions of dollars in trackable revenue across the various e-commerce marketplace, direct-to-consumer, and social commerce programs under management. Using research aggregated across these engagements, we accelerate results for our portfolio by developing high-impact digital strategies that unlock gateways to revenue growth, transform marketing operations, and prioritize profitability.

What started as a boutique design agency evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000), one of the most successful results-driven performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos), and esteemed recognition by Forbes 30 Under 30 for our founders’ contribution in Marketing & Advertising (Forbes).

About the Role

We are hiring an Email Marketing Specialist - a sharp, creative thinker with a passion for storytelling, conversion, and customer retention. This is not a plug-and-play execution role; it requires a high level of ownership, creative problem-solving, and a strong grasp of lifecycle marketing strategy. You’ll partner closely with Retention Managers and designers to develop and deploy high-performing email and SMS campaigns for some of the fastest-growing DTC brands in the world. From ideation and copywriting to QA and reporting, you'll be hands-on throughout the lifecycle, translating insights into messages that drive revenue, deepen loyalty, and elevate the customer experience.

Darkroom is a career accelerator for marketers who want to operate at the intersection of creativity, commerce, and performance, while mastering the tools and tactics of modern CRM strategy.

This is a fully remote role supporting a team in the EST time zone and is open to candidates based in Brazil, Portugal, Spain, Argentina, Colombia and Mexico.

A Day in the Life

  • Work directly with a Retention Marketing Manager to execute data-driven email and SMS strategies for our DTC/e-commerce clients.

  • On a daily basis, you will execute tasks for clients including writing, proofing, and scheduling email and SMS campaigns.

  • You’ll work directly with clients to manage the revision and approval process of their emails and SMS messages

  • On a monthly basis, you’ll develop creative campaign concepts for your client's retention marketing calendars.

  • You’ll work directly with our in-house design team to develop the design approach, ensuring the design vision for campaigns and flows comes to live, and managing the revision and approval process for client emails.

  • You’ll produce the copy for your campaign concepts and work directly with the client to gain approval on briefs before sending them to our in-house designers.

  • Driven and enjoy coming to the team and clients with new retention marketing ideas.

  • Execute automation/flow logic set-up, pop-up builds, and app integrations.

Who You Are:

We're looking for an Email Marketing Specialist to join our team! In this role, you will write email and SMS marketing copy, build and deploy email and SMS flows and campaigns, and develop content for our e-commerce, DTC clients.

  • You’re passionate about developing creative email and SMS marketing copy that drives loyalty and lifetime value for e-commerce clients.

  • You have experience working in Klaviyo or a similar ESP.

  • You’re passionate about marketing, and especially interested in learning and growing in the DTC and e-commerce marketing industry.

  • You’re a creative and experienced writer and looking to grow your career in marketing copywriting.

  • You're used to working in a fast-paced environment and can project manage multiple tasks at once for yourself, your team and your clients.

  • You dedicate time to learning and being on the cutting edge of trends and best practices in the world of DTC marketing.

You should apply if this sounds like you:

  • 2-4 years of work experience in digital marketing, copywriting, growth marketing, e-commerce, etc.

  • Past experience working at an agency or working with multiple clients in a fast-paced environment.

  • Experience working with Klaviyo or similar email service providers.

  • Enthusiastic, passionate, and creative; thrives on thinking outside of the box to create new best-in-class customer experiences.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication and presentation skills, plus the ability to clearly articulate and express complex and sometimes technical ideas to a wide variety of people and groups at any level.

Working at Darkroom

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players that want to build something great. There is no room in our organization for mediocrity and candidates that are not at the top of their game do not last. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world-class talent building something remarkable.

We believe in autonomy with accountability , truth over comfort , and outcomes over optics . If you want to build and win alongside some of the smartest people in the business, you’ll thrive here.

  • Location, location, (or no) location: Remote-first culture with a strong community base. With Hubs in the Bay Area, New York, Philly, Lisbon, Sao Paulo, and Barcelona!

  • Parental Leave: flexible parental leave benefits to support new parents during this important transition, ensuring time to bond with their families while maintaining work-life balance.

  • Endless opportunities for growth: Our agency is founded on an interdisciplinary approach, giving Darkroomers insights into services far beyond your job description. Grow your skills and interests beyond your niche and stay at the forefront of the industry through total immersion in cross-functional collaboration.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

title: Billing Analyst I
description:
Join to apply for the Billing Analyst I role at Airswift

About Us

Airswift is the leading workforce solutions provider to the STEM industries. For over 40 years Airswift has been transforming lives through the provision of international workforce solutions to STEM industries. Today, we are an integrated team of over 900 employees across 37 countries, supporting over 8,000 contractors globally.

We are a people business – we transform lives through the world of work. We care about wellbeing, community engagement and our planet – we plant a tree for every person placed in a job globally! We have a passion for growth, including investing in the development of our people.

We support professionals looking for jobs with exceptional firms in the technology, construction, and engineering sectors.

Role Description

The Billing Analyst will have responsibility for specific client accounts in Airswift's sales ledger covering the North American region. You will join a strong team based in our Rio de Janeiro office and will be tasked with ensuring fully compliant and timely billing for clients under your remit.

Principle Accountabilities

  • Assure billing for the assigned client portfolio.
  • Adhere to client billing requirements as per contracts and work orders, call off orders, purchase orders, etc.
  • Liaise closely with consultants on new clients and new client billing requirements.
  • Ensure accuracy and completeness of billing, including recharges to clients.
  • Ensure timely delivery of invoices to clients along with a variety of supporting documentation.
  • Ensure reporting to the Supervisor of any un-invoiced, missed, or incorrect amount that is not billed timely manner to the client or becomes aged.
  • Ensure timely response to clients (external and internal) and report to the direct Supervisor of specific customer requests for timely delivery.
  • Report on funded invoices to the billing supervisor accurately and in a timely fashion.
  • Ensure all banking information is correct on invoices as per funded or non-funded category, currency, and billing entity.
  • Follow up on invoices emailed to clients or via consultants to confirm receipt.
  • Reconcile client VMS (vendor management system) with an internal invoicing system to ensure invoices are correctly submitted.
  • Monitor the status of invoices that were previously sent by email, portal, or VMS systems for any rejections that require correction.
  • Ensure intercompany invoices are issued correctly and timely manner between Airswift's legal entities.
  • Work to the month-end deadlines.
  • Compare invoices from Tempest (payroll and billing system) to invoices generated in Amalto to ensure all relevant information has been saved in SharePoint and maintained in line with auditing requirements.
  • Import invoices to Dynamics 365 (financial ERP system), and balance payroll and billing Tempest to D365, ensuring all billing has been captured.
  • Complete submittal logs in a timely fashion and attend weekly submittal meetings with the Billing Supervisor.
  • Ensure all invoices and backups are filed in a shared drive and maintained.
  • Complete queries in a 48‑hour turnaround (outside of main invoicing schedules) and maintain and complete query log.
  • Liaise with payroll to validate any payroll adjustments affected by credit notes and complete credit note logs for auditing purposes.
  • Review new client contracts with the Billing Supervisor to ensure all requirements are captured.
  • Ensure Bullhorn (client management system) data is correct and highlight errors to consultants and service teams accordingly.
  • Meet accuracy targets in line with KPIS.
  • Purchase order and work order analysis.
  • Maintain and deliver 3rd‑party reconciliations and advise the billing supervisor of details to pay – this is working with credit control to ascertain paid invoices (pay when paid basis).
  • Communicate with various parties of the PO analysis ceilings to ensure timely delivery of either renewed PO value or extended PO.
  • Support function for MIDE region invoicing as and when required.
  • Be fully involved in working with credit control to reduce DSO and improve the liquidity of Airswift for the North American region.
  • Follow company policies and procedures, guidelines, and standards.
  • Ad hoc duties as and when required.

Skills, Knowledge, and Experience

  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills
  • 1+ years of experience in a finance function (billing experience preferred, but not required).
  • Knowledge of multi-currency transactions.
  • Knowledge of VAT and WHT is beneficial.
  • Strong attention to detail.
  • Ability to work in a challenging environment with the ability to meet deadlines and adapt to changing priorities.
  • Experience in liaising with various internal departments.
  • Focused and dedicated mindset.
  • Good team player with the ability to drive changes and improvements.
  • Knowledge of funding and non-funding.
  • Knowledge of withholding tax (training provided).

What we can offer you!

  • Attractive monthly base salary + competitive commission/performance bonus.
  • Genuine career progression opportunities, either locally or globally!
  • World‑class training programmes and development opportunities.
  • Virtual Onboarding Events exclusively for new hires.
  • Team driven environment, supportive culture with a focus on work‑life balance.
  • Career breaks available after one year.
  • Real time recognition through our employee reward platform.
  • Mental Health First Aiders to signpost you to support when you need it.
  • Yearly destination trips as part of our High Flyers program (Dubai, Buenos Aires, etc…)
  • Charity days for various important causes such as Relay for Life and Earth Day.

Our Core Values

  • Growth - In life and business, one must grow to flourish and achieve high ambitions. Growth requires change, challenge, risk and sacrifice - we will always choose growth.
  • Life – Above all else, we value life. The quality of life, both in and outside of work, profoundly influences our well-being and our impact on the world.
  • Excellence - We deliver, holding ourselves accountable for results. Our customers see excellence in everything we do.
  • Integrity - We are ethical, open, honest and authentic. People trust us to do the right thing for the right reason.

Visit our website and social media to find out more! -

Disclaimer

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by people assigned to this classification. They are not to be construed as an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, and skills required of personnel so classified. All personnel may be required to perform duties outside of their normal responsibilities from time to time, as needed.

Diversity & Inclusion

At Airswift, we believe that diversity is critical to our success and makes us a great place to work. We are committed to building an equal opportunity workplace, the more inclusive we are - the better our work will be.

Especialista Tributário – Foco em Tributos Federais

A Supergasbras é uma empresa do grupo holandês SHV Energy, líder mundial na distribuição de Gás liquefeito de Petróleo (GLP), com mais de 100 anos de experiência. Nosso negócio é levar energia limpa e eficiente para milhões de brasileiros, seja nas suas casas, comércios, indústrias ou agronegócio. Os mais de 76 anos de atuação no Brasil nos posiciona como uma das principais distribuidoras nacionais de GLP - comercializamos cerca de 1,5 milhão de toneladas do produto por ano com aproximadamente 20% de participação de mercado.

Desenvolvemos uma série de projetos com foco em transformação digital, experiência do cliente, inovação e desenvolvimento sustentável do negócio. Nossa estratégia é conseguir através da confiança e integridade, ser a melhor empresa de Energia do Brasil para nossos clientes, parceiros, colaboradores e acionistas, com responsabilidade socioambiental.

Diversidade e inclusão é uma prioridade de negócios para a Supergasbras. Valorizamos e acreditamos no desenvolvimento de pessoas, tanto no contexto profissional como pessoal, tendo como estratégia a equidade de gênero, inclusão de pessoas com deficiência, respeito a todas as orientações sexuais e luta contra a discriminação racial nas diferentes camadas da sociedade.

Ser diverso é ser Super!

Esta oportunidade também está publicada no portal global de vagas da SHV Energy e faz parte do nosso compromisso de atrair talentos que compartilham dos nossos valores, independente da localização.

Responsabilidades e atribuições Objetivo do Cargo

A posição de Especialista Tributário tem como objetivo liderar tecnicamente as estratégias de compliance e defesa tributária da empresa, com foco em tributos federais diretos (especialmente IRPJ e CSLL), atuando de forma proativa na gestão de riscos, na condução de processos de contencioso administrativo, interpretação e normatização de legislação federal e na identificação de oportunidades fiscais. Este profissional será referência técnica na área, com papel consultivo e estratégico junto às demais áreas da empresa e escritórios externos.

Responsabilidades do Cargo
  • Liderar tecnicamente a apuração e revisão dos tributos federais diretos (especialmente IRPJ e CSLL),
  • Coordenar métodos de revisão de obrigações acessórias federais (ECF, ECD, EFD-Contribuições, DCTFWeb, PER/DCOMP, REINF, entre outras) atuando ocasionalmente na sua elaboração.
  • Atuar diretamente na condução de processos administrativos tributários, elaborando defesas, recursos e acompanhando julgamentos e fiscalizações em geral.
  • Desenvolver e implementar melhorias nos processos tributários, com foco em automação e eficiência, gestão de metas e indicadores da área, aprimorando suas habilidades para um perfil crítico e analítico.
  • Representar a empresa junto a órgãos públicos e escritórios jurídicos em temas tributários.
  • Monitorar e interpretar mudanças na legislação tributária federal, em especial a Reforma Tributária, propondo estratégias de adequação de processos internos e aproveitamento de oportunidades.
  • Ser membro ativo e protagonista dos impactos da Reforma Tributária do Consumo (e outras reformas) desde a interpretação da legislação até adequações sistêmicas.
  • Apoiar em planejamento tributário, projetos especiais e na estruturação de operações com impacto fiscal.

Instructional Designer - Relocate to Saudi Arabia, Permanent Expat Relocation Package

Position in Aramco, requiring full relocation to Saudi Arabia. Permanent full‑time expatriate family relocation package.

Job Overview

We are seeking a qualified and creative Instructional Designer to develop learning experiences for the Downstream Learning and Development Department (DLDD) that enhance downstream workforce capability. You will work closely with subject‑matter experts (SMEs), training stakeholders, and internal partners to design evidence‑based instructional solutions and evaluate performance.

Key Responsibilities

  • Analyze learning needs and performance gaps to design effective instructional solutions.
  • Design and develop detailed instructional design documents, storyboards, scripts, and learning outlines.
  • Review learning activities, curricula, and course materials that drive effective knowledge transfer and on‑the‑job performance.
  • Define clear instructional goals and ensure all training materials, assessments, and learning assets align with objectives.
  • Create engaging exercises, activities, and multimedia elements that enhance learner engagement and support skill application.
  • Design and produce polished PowerPoint presentations for instructor‑led and virtual training sessions.
  • Evaluate programs using data, feedback, and performance metrics to recommend improvements.
  • Maintain accurate project documentation, course files, and version control across DLDD systems.
  • Collaborate with SMEs to translate complex information into clear, engaging learning assets.
  • Assess, manage, and work with external training vendors to ensure training programs meet DLDD standards for design, development, and delivery.
  • Stay current with learning trends, emerging technologies, and best practices in instructional design and workforce development.
  • Design assessments, quizzes, and evaluation strategies aligned with measurable learning outcomes.
  • Apply adult learning principles, learning science theories, and user experience best practices to all solutions.
  • Conduct usability testing, gather learner feedback, and iterate designs for continuous improvement.
  • Ensure learning materials meet accessibility standards and follow organizational branding.

Qualifications

  • A Bachelor’s degree in Instructional Design, Education, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Minimum of 5 years’ experience in instructional design, curriculum development, or program evaluation.
  • Strong understanding of adult learning principles, instructional design frameworks, and evaluation methodologies.
  • Experience designing and developing training content aligned with learning objectives and organizational needs.
  • Proficiency with e‑learning authoring tools such as Articulate Storyline, Articulate Rise, and Adobe Captivate.
  • Familiarity with graphic design and multimedia tools such as Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, Premiere Pro, or Camtasia.
  • Ability to create simple visual assets, animations, or interactive elements using tools like Canva, Vyond, or similar platforms.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with diverse stakeholders.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and project management skills.
  • Familiarity with AI‑assisted learning design tools to support efficiency and innovation in training development.
  • Advanced proficiency with PowerPoint for designing instructor‑led content, visual layouts, and prototypes.
  • Solid foundation in learning science and the ability to design engaging, learner‑centered content across digital, instructor‑led, and blended delivery formats.

Working Environment

Our high‑performing employees are drawn to challenging and rewarding professional, technical, and industrial opportunities, and are remunerated accordingly. At Aramco, we invest heavily in talent development and provide world‑scale projects with significant capital and technology investment.

Aramco energizes the world economy with one of the largest hydrocarbon producer portfolios and a commitment to enhance value to society. Headquartered in Saudi Arabia, Aramco combines market discipline with a generations‑spanning view of the future, driving significant societal and economic benefits to communities worldwide.

description:
A family-owned company, bioMérieux has grown to become a world leader in the field of in vitro diagnostics . For more than 60 years and across the world, we have imagined and developed innovative diagnostics solutions to improve public health . Today, our teams are spread across 45 countries and serve 160 countries with the support of a large distribution network.

Come and join a family-owned global company with a long‑term vision, and a human‑centered culture.

REGIONAL COMPENSATION & BENEFITS PARTNER, LATIN AMERICA

MISSION OVERVIEW

The Regional C&B Partner, LATAM, will lead the Compensation & Benefits strategy for Latin America, ensuring internal equity, external competitiveness, and support for business transformation, while maintaining consistency with global practices, adapting to local needs, and maintaining an employee value proposition that remains consistent and attractive across Latin America.

The Regional C&B Partner, LATAM, will report to the Sr. Director, Human Resources - Latin America.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Market Trend Monitoring
    • Stay updated on compensation and benefits practices in the region to maintain competitiveness.
    • Conduct and analyze external compensation surveys and market trends to develop innovative compensation initiatives and manage cyclical activities such as open enrollment
  • Bridge Between Global and Regional Teams and Business Leaders
    • Act as a liaison between the global compensation team and regional leaders, translating business needs into appropriate policies and programs.
    • Partner with managers to define compensation packages that ensure internal equity and external competitiveness.
    • Train HRBPs and leaders on C&B practices, career ranges, and JA as a tool for dialogue and development.
    • Support Transformation Projects in the region (integrations, restructures, new businesses), ensuring pay/benefits structures enable change.
  • Data Management and Analysis
    • Ensure accurate and timely data for salary reviews, inflation, offers, benefits, and structural adjustments.
    • Support or coordinate the region’s participation in market surveys according to local practices.
    • Perform comprehensive audits to verify the accuracy, compliance, and integrity of compensation practices and data within the system of record.
    • Ensure adherence to Job Architecture (families, streams, levels, profiles) as the foundation for pay structures, career paths, and communication.
    • Conduct ad‑hoc reviews (turnover due to pay, attraction challenges, organizational changes) and recommend market positioning adjustments.
  • Benefits & Total Rewards
    • Map, benchmark, and optimize benefits packages (health, life, meal, transportation, mobility, wellness, retirement), balancing harmonization and local customization across Latin America.
    • Manage vendors and administrators (negotiation, SLAs, quality, employee experience) and lead flex benefits projects.
  • Policy Communication and Implementation
    • Guarantee that global, regional, and Local policies are communicated and applied correctly, including merit cycles, inflation, benefits, promotions, and incentive programs.
    • Implement and develop Regional policies aligned with global practices.
    • Reviewed and validated the local policies, ensuring that they are aligned with the Global policies and strategies.
  • Support Global Compensation Philosophy
    • Contribute to the execution of global strategies, including short- and long‑term incentive programs, equity plans, and process governance.
    • Lead the design and end‑to‑end management of compensation programs, including salary adjustments, inflation, bonuses, and rewards, benefits ensuring strategic alignment and compliance.

STUDIES & EXPERIENCES

  • Degree in Business, Economics, Engineering, Psychology, or related; MBA/post‑grad preferred.
  • Expected 8–12+ years in Compensation & Benefits/Total Rewards, with multi‑country LATAM exposure.
  • Expertise in Job Architecture, job evaluation/levelling, and market pricing with global providers.
  • Experience in managing pay structures, incentives (STI/LTI), mobility, benefits, and compensation analytics, and tools and benchmarks (Mercer, WTW, CompAnalyst), Excel/BI, HRIS/ERP systems.

SOFT SKILLS:

  • Analytical thinking & synthetic mindset
  • Leader by Influence
  • Team spirit and customer‑oriented
  • Ability to work in a matrix environment with cross‑cultural flexibility ;
  • Problem‑solving and teamwork abilities.
  • Excellent interpersonal communication skills.
  • Creative & out‑of‑the‑box thinker
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Leadership and communication – Assertiveness.
  • Ability to work in a fast‑paced, dynamic environment.
  • ethics/confidentiality

LANGUAGE: Fluent in Spanish and English. Portuguese will be a plus.

WORKING CONDITIONS: This role could be a hybrid model or home office model.

LOCATION: The position could be based in any subsidiary of Latin America, such as Brasil, México, Chile, Colombia, and Argentina.

Executivo de vendas Sr. - Canal direto/indireto

Na Trane TechnologiesTM e através dos nossos negócios, incluindo a Trane® e a Thermo King®, criamos soluções climáticas inovadoras para edifícios, casas e transportes que desafiam o que é possível para um mundo sustentável. Somos uma equipe que ousa olhar para os desafios do mundo e enxergar possibilidades impactantes. Acreditamos em um futuro melhor quando elevamos os outros e permitimos que nosso pessoal prospere no trabalho e em casa. Desafiamos audaciosamente o que é possível para um mundo sustentável.

O que a Trane pode te oferecer?

Faça parte da nossa missão! Como líder global na criação de ambientes confortáveis, sustentáveis e eficientes, é nossa responsabilidade colocar o planeta em primeiro lugar. Para nós da Trane Technologies, a sustentabilidade não é apenas a forma como fazemos negócios, é o nosso negócio. Você se atreve a olhar para os desafios do mundo e ver possibilidades impactantes? Quer contribuir para um futuro melhor? Se a resposta for sim, convidamos você a considerar se juntar a nós para desafiar corajosamente o que é possível para um mundo sustentável.

Estamos em busca de um Executivo(a) de Vendas para o nosso canal de vendas Diretas/Indiretas. Nesta função você será responsável por desenvolver relacionamentos de longo prazo com proprietários de edifícios para maximizar a penetração da conta e a retenção de clientes com instaladores, projetistas e cliente final. Fornecerá conhecimento e aconselhamento sob a forma de desenvolvimento de soluções para os problemas dos clientes, incluindo considerações financeiras e baseadas no desempenho. Seu foco será fornecer aos clientes uma solução total para os edifícios mais eficientes em termos energéticos.

Prospere No Trabalho e Em Casa

Prosperar tanto no trabalho quanto em casa, graças a benefícios significativos, flexibilidade e oportunidades de crescimento. Oferecemos amplos benefícios para apoiar nossos funcionários e suas famílias, que incluem:

  • Oportunidade de participar do programa de Seguro médico e de Vida privado da empresa, após o cumprimento dos requisitos de elegibilidade, seguindo as políticas, termos e condições estabelecidos pela empresa.
  • Você terá acesso ao Programa de Bem-Estar, que fornece recursos para apoiar o bem-estar emocional, legal e financeiro seu e de sua família.
  • Também terá a oportunidade de aproveitar oportunidades de aprendizado contínuo através dos nossos Programa de Formação Contínua.
  • Como parte do nosso compromisso com a responsabilidade social, você terá direito a um dia completo (8 horas) de tempo livre remunerado por ano para realizar tarefas de voluntariado em organizações beneficentes sem fins lucrativos, através do nosso programa de Voluntariado de Funcionários.
  • Caso enfrente dificuldades econômicas inesperadas, o fundo Helping Hands Fund da Trane Technologies está disponível para oferecer apoio aos nossos funcionários.

Nossa Oportunidade

Estamos buscando profissionais que sejam de São Paulo (Capital), Rio de Janeiro ou região do Nordeste (Salvador ou Recife) para fazer parte do nosso time.

Suas Principais Atividades

  • Determinar necessidades, desenvolver e executar um plano de negócios específico da conta para identificar os requisitos de suporte mútuo de longo prazo necessários para facilitar uma parceria forte, lucrativa e bem-sucedida.
  • Transformar leads em oportunidades mapeando o processo de vendas correto, identificando os membros necessários da equipe do projeto, fazendo atribuições e comunicando as próximas etapas do processo.
  • Coletar e validar informações preliminares e realizar uma visita às instalações, revisão do plano de construção ou outros requisitos.
  • Responder pela decolagem do projeto, seleção, precificação de propostas e estratégia de vendas, e integração de equipes, controles e serviços.
  • Ajudar os clientes a responder a perguntas técnicas sobre sistemas HVAC, produtos Trane e alternativas de aplicação de sistemas, controles, instalação, operação, manutenção e solução de problemas.
  • É necessário deslocar-se aos locais de trabalho do cliente, o que pode incluir trabalho ao ar livre e/ou trabalho mecânico/sala de equipamentos. Join to apply for the Social Media Brand Strategist role at Toptal

Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue and team members based around the globe , Toptal is the world’s largest fully remote workforce.

We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold.

Job Summary

As a Social Media Brand Strategist for a new venture within Toptal, you will work directly with the General Manager and the Operations Director to onboard, coach, and accelerate the growth of our Content Creator users. You will join an execution-driven team building a new business unit from zero. Your mindset must be that of a builder, not just a coach.

This role has two core missions:

  • Deliver hands‑on creator growth: You will coach creators 1‑to‑1 to grow their audience, increase their engagement, and monetize their content. You will analyze their entire content plan end‑to‑end. You will challenge them with personalized weekly tasks that improve key metrics such as click‑through‑rate, retention rate, followers growth, and engagement rate. Once creators reach strong traction, you will also identify new revenue opportunities and activate brand deals.
  • Build the foundations of the Creator Agent function: As our first full‑time Social Media Brand Strategist, you will design, test, and refine the methodologies that power our coaching model. You will transform your learnings into structured playbooks, training materials, and repeatable processes that will allow us to scale a high‑performing agent team.

This is not a passive coaching position. You will think like a strategist, operate like a creator, and build like an early‑stage founder. You must be able to analyze performance data, communicate clearly, and move quickly.

The ideal candidate is a senior creator strategist with real, proven experience growing accounts on YouTube, Instagram, or TikTok. You understand how content scales, why packaging matters, and how to push creators to become consistent, professional, and commercially ready.

This is a remote position. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.

Responsibilities

The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills.

  • Conduct creators onboarding, assess performance, and identify growth opportunities across platforms.
  • Provide 1‑to‑1 coaching focused on improving content strategy, packaging, and execution (from scripting to community building).
  • Define weekly goals and metrics that drive measurable growth.
  • Guide creators toward professional publishing standards and consistent audience development.
  • Support creators in preparing for monetization and activate brand opportunities when appropriate.
  • Design, test, and refine the coaching methodologies that will scale the Creator Agent function.
  • Convert insights into structured playbooks, templates, and training materials for future agents.
  • Partner with the Operations Director to strengthen creator success processes and growth frameworks.
  • Collaborate with marketing, product, and partnerships teams on creator‑facing initiatives.
  • Stay ahead of platform trends, algorithm shifts, and best practices to update our approach continuously.
  • Exercise discretion and independent judgment.

Qualifications and Job Requirements

  • A bachelor’s degree is required.
  • Proven experience growing social media accounts on YouTube, Instagram, and/or TikTok.
  • Strong understanding of content strategy fundamentals: ideation, hooks, titles, thumbnails, and retention, conversion, and community building.
  • Ability to analyze performance data and translate insights into clear, actionable guidance.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
  • Experience in roles that require coaching, advising, or client accountability.
  • Ability to break down creative work into structured frameworks and teachable steps.
  • Strong organizational discipline to manage around 10 creators weekly.
  • Availability to work in the Americas time zone.
  • Familiarity with creator monetization and brand partnerships is a plus.
  • Are a creator with +50k followers/subscribers on Instagram, YouTube, or TikTok.
  • Have monetized your own content through different sources, including brand deals, affiliate marketing, platform payouts, and selling products/services to your own audience.
  • Are familiar with doing paid social campaigns.

The purpose of this role is to lead the set-up, operation, and maintenance of the FIFA Volunteer Platform, which serves as the foundation for the entire volunteer experience. The successful candidate will also oversee essential system integrations to ensure a seamless, efficient, and high-quality operational process for the tournament.

This role will work in close collaboration with the Volunteer Management Teams at FIFA Zurich, FIFA27, Host Cities in Brazil and the FIFA Volunteer Platform provider, as well as with other Functional Areas, to ensure the technology platforms meet all operational requirements while supporting the successful delivery of the Volunteer Programme.

We are seeking an innovative and experienced systems professional with a proven record in managing complex, large-scale event operations. The ideal candidate will join a dynamic, multicultural environment and bring both strategic insight and firsthand expertise to one of the most exciting sporting events in the world.

Key responsibilities

  • Work on development of all system processes in the FIFA volunteer platform, from application through to tournament-time management, including test events and satellite events
  • Participate in the planning phase to finalise configuration of the FIFA Volunteer Platform ensuring it fully supports the requirements of the Integrated Model for a consistent volunteer experience and operational processes across all Host Cities.
  • Support the review and refine system functionalities to meet the evolving needs of the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™.
  • Ensure operational readiness to test and finalise the application form for the Volunteer Programme launch.
  • Ensure integration with other FIFA and local systems, managing all dependencies.
  • Act as the volunteer department’s main point of contact for User Access, User Validation, UAT (User Acceptance Testing), and system simulations.
  • Identify and propose technical solutions to operational challenges not addressed by existing functionality.
  • Ensure data integrity, compliance, and security across all volunteer systems in‑line with FIFA’s data protection standards.
  • Act as the first point of escalation and resolution for volunteer system issues.
  • Promote best practices in data management, analytics, and system governance.
  • Lead the creation of data reports, dashboards, and analytical tools for operational insights and decision‑making.
  • Monitor and report on project timelines, change requests, and system risks in line with the integrated volunteer systems plan.
  • Establish clear reporting and monitoring processes to evaluate programme effectiveness, volunteer satisfaction, and service delivery.
  • Lead the preparation and delivery of training materials and conduct “Train‑the‑Trainer” sessions for system users.
  • Ensure compliance to the FIFA tournament guidelines and oversee project execution in alignment with the approved budget, identifying efficiencies and cost‑effective delivery methods.
  • Contribute to the development and implementation of an International Volunteer Welcome Strategy, including logistics, visa facilitation, and cultural integration.
  • Ensure a structured systems close‑out process, including comprehensive handover and debrief report.
  • Represent the Volunteer team in cross‑functional area meetings, host city briefings, readiness workshops, stakeholder engagements, and strategic planning.

Your profile

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in large‑scale volunteer, workforce, or sport event programme management.
  • Education: Master’s in Sports Management or Event Management or Technology, Information Systems, or Project Management preferred.
  • Proven experience managing large‑scale technology or systems implementation projects.
  • Excellent organisational, communication, and project management skills.
  • Strong analytical and reporting skills, including proficiency with data visualisation and business intelligence tools.
  • High cultural awareness with experience in multi‑stakeholder and multicultural environments.
  • Training delivery experience a plus
  • Familiarity with volunteer management systems (Rosterfy) and related IT tools is highly desirable.
  • Ability to be flexible and adopt an innovative mindset
  • Team player with internal and external stakeholders
  • Ability to thrive in an international, dynamic, and fast‑paced environment.
  • Collaborative and empathetic team player, passionate about community‑building, sport, and service.
  • Creativity and resourcefulness to enhance the volunteer experience and drive engagement.
  • Anticipates needs, understands the strategic impact of systems, and drives continuous improvement.
  • Project management or Systems Management certification is desired
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re‑locate to Rio de Janeiro.

About FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027

The FIFA Women’s World Cup™ is the greatest women’s sporting event on the planet, showcasing the best players in the world on the biggest stage. In 2027, history will be made as Brazil welcomes the tournament to South America for the first time ever.

This landmark event will unite the world through an unprecedented celebration of women’s football, inspiring billions of fans across the globe. As we prepare to host teams and supporters from every corner of the world, we’re looking for passionate, talented individuals to be part of history and help deliver an unforgettable tournament.

Join us and play your role in making FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ a truly extraordinary experience that celebrates and elevates women’s football.

Rio De Janeiro, Rio De Janeiro, Brasil

Somos muito mais do que uma empresa de maquininhas! A Stone é uma empresa de tecnologia e serviços financeiros focada no(a) cliente.

Nascemos com o propósito de ser protagonistas na transformação da indústria de pagamentos, servindo o(a) empreendedor(a) brasileiro(a) e transformando seus sonhos em resultados.

Somos a maior empresa independente de meios de pagamentos do Brasil, com mais de quinze mil pessoas espalhadas pelas cinco regiões do país, em um cenário repleto de desafios e oportunidades. Valorizamos o trabalho em equipe, a flexibilidade, o desenvolvimento contínuo e os pensamentos disruptivos e incansáveis na busca de soluções para a nossa RAZÃO.

A nossa cultura se manifesta em cada encontro e em cada diálogo, seja entre colegas de trabalho ou com clientes, seja nas reuniões internas ou em nossas respostas às transformações do mercado e aos momentos de adversidade.

Desejamos que cada pessoa sinta orgulho de ser quem é e que sinta ainda mais orgulho de fazer parte da nossa história.

A essência de "ser quem você é" nos guia, inspirando a construção diária de um ambiente livre, que celebra e valoriza as singularidades. Sabemos que cada pessoa traz consigo uma perspectiva única e valiosa. O que nos une é a inteligência, a energia e a integridade – virtudes que podem e devem ser cultivadas em qualquer pessoa.

Nos dedicaremos todos os dias para garantir que nossas práticas, nossa cultura e nosso ambiente estejam sempre orientados pela inclusão, acessibilidade e respeito.

Por aqui, vivemos nossa cultura no dia a dia, guiados por esses 5 pilares:

Own It: Ter espírito de dono te faz conquistar a liberdade. Valorizamos a autonomia e a proatividade, somos responsáveis pelo o que entregamos e queremos sempre evoluir o nosso negócio.

Live the Ride: Faça. Feito é melhor que perfeito. Aprendemos com os erros e encaramos desafios como oportunidades de aprendizado.

No Bullshit: Agir com simplicidade. Somos pessoas práticas, sinceras e gostamos de feedbacks. Sabemos que às vezes vamos errar e contamos com essa transparência para evoluirmos.

Team Play: Se quer ir rápido, vá sozinho(a). Se quer ir longe, trabalhe em equipe. É sempre possível aprender com as outras pessoas e a colaboração é a chave do sucesso.

The Reason: O cliente não tem razão, ele é a razão. Queremos gerar impacto para nosso(a) cliente, quando enxergamos a melhoria que causamos na vida dele(a), é que sabemos que fizemos uma boa entrega.

O nosso verde é plural e sempre acolherá todas as pessoas!

Nossa missão é conquistar novos clientes de forma ativa e consultiva através do canal telefônico. Para isso, fazemos um atendimento personalizado com o objetivo de entregar as melhores experiências para o cliente. O time de Outbound está em expansão com o desafio de aumentar a base de clientes através da oferta dos nossos produtos de adquirência.

Como é ser um(a) Analista Comercial de Inside Sales no time de Outbound:

Através do conhecimento sobre o nosso negócio e nossos produtos, você irá realizar as vendas ativas por meio de uma ferramenta de discagem automática.

Você será responsável por realizar vendas ativas aplicando nosso processo de venda, diagnosticando as demandas do cliente, conectando as necessidades dele com as nossas soluções financeiras e com foco em um atendimento de excelência!

Principais responsabilidades:

  • Atender as ligações realizadas pela discagem automática;
  • Diagnosticar a necessidade do(a) cliente e conectar nossas soluções para o fechamento da venda;
  • Ter uma boa organização dos clientes em negociação, se certificando de fazer follow-up;
  • Gerar proposta no sistema e certificar que está entregando a melhor proposta ao cliente, acompanhando até o fechamento;
  • Acompanhar seus resultados e do time através de dashboards e reuniões.

O que esperamos de você:

  • Experiência prévia com vendas ativas via telefone (no mínimo 1 ano);
  • Conhecimento de técnicas de vendas;
  • Ensino superior (cursando ou concluído);
  • Habilidades de negociação e influência;
  • Boa oratória e escrita;
  • Capacidade de priorização e de lidar com múltiplas tarefas;
  • Habilidade com ferramentas de CRM (ex: Salesforce);
  • Estar sempre em busca de novas atualizações sobre produtos e ofertas da companhia.

O que aumenta suas chances:

  • Conhecimento em gestão de funil de vendas;
  • Capacidade analítica ( ex.: Leitura de Dashboard);
  • Habilidades com gerenciamento de processos;
  • Facilidade com atendimento ao telefone.

Jornada de Trabalho:

  • CLT: 8 horas diárias + 1h de intervalo | Com horário de 09h às 18h | Escala: 5x2 (segunda a sexta) com eventuais escalas aos sábados (opcional).

Modelo e Local de trabalho:

  • Presencial | Cinelândia - Rio de Janeiro/ RJ.

  • Hospital Virtual Verde disponível 24 horas por dia, 7 dias por semana, de forma rápida e prática

Novos Benefícios - Em breve, teremos benefícios exclusivos para pessoas com deficiência.

Etapas do Processo Seletivo:

  • Inscrição: Aqui você começa a sua jornada conosco realizando seu cadastro e alguns testes.. Fique tranquilo(a), nosso time analisará as informações do seu perfil e entrará em contato em breve. Boa sorte!
  • Questionário de Vida: Este é o momento de te conhecermos! Você deverá preencher um questionário com o objetivo de apresentar sua trajetória, hobbies, motivações e sonhos.
  • Entrevistas com o time de People: Você terá um papo inicial com nosso time de recrutamento, com o objetivo de conhecer nossa cultura, estrutura e o desafio que está sendo proposto.
  • Entrevista com a Liderança: Nesta etapa vamos nos aprofundar nas suas hard skills com o objetivo de avaliar habilidades e competências específicas para a vaga. Além de te apresentar possíveis pares e liderança.
  • Check de Cultura: Nossa cultura é muito importante e está sempre presente no dia a dia! Aqui, você terá um papo com uma das nossas pessoas guardiãs da cultura, com o objetivo de nos conhecer e garantir que nossas crenças, nosso jeito de pensar e nossa visão de futuro estão alinhadas com o que você acredita e busca vivenciar.
  • Feedback: Uma de nossas forças é a franqueza. Por isso, independente do resultado, iremos compartilhá-lo com você e alinhar os próximos passos.

E aí? Curtiu? Então, não deixa de se inscrever e #VemSerStone

Aqui na Stone Co., valorizamos e procuramos as melhores pessoas para nos ajudar a melhorar a vida das pessoas empreendedoras do Brasil. Nosso sonho é do tamanho do universo e, se você se identifica com o nosso propósito, venha construí-lo com a gente!

title: Executivo(a) de Vendas Long Tail
description:
About The Company

Se para você a tecnologia existe para melhorar o caminho da vida, para o nosso time também: Seu Caminho, Nossa Jornada.

Acreditamos na tecnologia que conecta gente boa no que faz e que vive a diversidade para criar e compartilhar até os caminhos que a gente (ainda!) nem sabe quais são. Trabalhamos para gerar valor não só para os nossos usuários, mas, sobretudo, para as comunidades que servimos e toda a sociedade, tornando a vida das pessoas melhor com serviços que facilitem seu dia a dia - seja com serviços de mobilidade e entrega (99) ou pagamentos digitais (99Pay).

Para facilitar a vida de milhões de pessoas todos os dias, desde 2018 fazemos parte da DiDi Global Inc., a maior plataforma de tecnologia e transporte por aplicativo do mundo. Somos pioneiros na criação de soluções inovadoras que começam no Brasil e que ganham escala para gerar impacto positivo em mais de 12 países em que a DiDi está presente. Essas inovações passam por sustentabilidade, segurança, inteligência artificial, mercado financeiro e um tanto mais.

Seja para construir projetos do zero ou aprimorar nossas soluções, gostamos de desafios que nos fazem sentir frio na barriga, e é por isso que trabalhamos num ritmo acelerado, com respeito, colaboração e bom humor. Nessa jornada, também nos fortalecemos nas diferentes vivências e opiniões para crescermos juntos, errar rápido, aprender e ajustar o caminho para criar soluções que tragam ainda melhores resultados.

About The Team/role

Our Sales Coordinators will work in DriverLab’s team, focused on innovation projects for our drivers. Being part of the DriverLab team will give you the unique opportunity to help drive growth in one of the fastest growing companies ever.

This role is based on developing new partnerships, coordinating the sales vertical in a new region, leading the acquisition and the partnership development, through the deal with gas stations to join the new 99’s marketplace: 99Abastece. Be prepared for a fast‑paced, challenging and joyful environment.

In this role, you'll be

  • Focus on great execution with the sales team to develop new partnerships on the 99Abastece business, being responsible for the initial contact stage, until the completion of the onboarding process and the engagement dynamics.
  • Support team management: manage acquisition, activation and support team (third party).
  • Close relationship with portfolio customers, promoting a good experience and strategic consulting for partners, aiming at greater profitability.
  • Ensure collaboration with stakeholders teams to improve operational productivity (marketing, S&Ops, HR, legal, procurement).
  • Create a fun, inclusive, and safe work culture: you will help build a hard‑working, challenging but fun workplace and be responsible for ensuring engagement and development of your team.

We're eager to be in touch because you have

  • 4 – 5 years of experience in sales B2B/B2C, fuel market, food delivery, strategy consulting or other professional services with a proven track record in using data to drive business decisions.
  • Great ability of negotiation and relationship.
  • Availability for business travels around twice a month.
  • Experience in team management.
  • Proven self‑motivation, self‑direction, and eagerness to take ownership of tasks to ensure solutions.
  • Intermediate English knowledge: the position may require eventual interaction with international stakeholders living in Brazil and abroad.
  • Distinctive problem‑solving ability – to break down ambiguous problems, put structure and use data‑driven insights to solve them.
  • Clear communication – you are a clear and concise communicator with the ability to synthesize a lot of information quickly and highlight the key insights.
  • Comfortable learning and using new software tools and working in a business with constant changes.

You’ll love working at DiDi because

We create user value

We strive to always create valuable experiences for our users in everything we do. Our focus is to always innovate new experiences that are safe, pleasant and efficient.

We are data‑driven

We are strong believers in making informed decisions, that’s why we are data-driven. We can better navigate the business landscape strategically by analyzing valuable metrics.

Win‑win Collaboration

Success is a team sport. When we work to help our partners and colleagues win, we win, too. While keeping everyone's best interest at heart, we communicate with candor and execute with excellence in all we do.

We believe in integrity

Integrity is at the very core of our business. We are people who always want to do the right thing. Our intentions are sincere, we speak our minds and listen to each other.

Growth

We always strive to do better. That means venturing beyond our comfort zones, learning from our mistakes, and helping each other grow.

Diversity and Inclusion

Diversity is one of our biggest strengths. Our differences are what make us distinct. We respect each other and believe in equal opportunities for all.

Diversity & Inclusion

Diversity is not a vision of the future or something we wish to have one day, it is a non‑negotiable value of who we are. We practice inclusion, plurality, and respect. And we count on the governance of the Diversity Committee, which works together with HR, leadership and identity groups – 99Adapta, 99Afro, 99Cores, 99Mulheres, and 99Mamães. This part of our journey has been written, there remains a long road before us.

We reinforce that this position is open to everyone, including pregnant people and people with disabilities (PwD).
